name: karyakshetram
description: Karyakshetram — retail expansion intelligence (MERN). Run `npm run setup`, then `npm run seed`, then `npm run dev:server` and `npm run dev:client` in two terminals.

scripts.setup: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.build: npm --prefix client install --include=dev && npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix server install
